description: Lower-side auxin asymmetry in the root tip vs gravity level. MODEL OUTPUT of the virtual-root mechanistic auxin-transport model (columella PIN-bias sweep), not a measurement. Used by the seed twin only to scale the gravitropic bending rate relative to 1 g.
unit: percent lower-side auxin asymmetry vs. gravity level (g)
interpolation: piecewise-linear between points, clamp to [0,2]g range
